scope: Step C dev selection; original holdout and reserve are separately reported regression validations already seen during D.
fixed_k: Known manifest K is an explicitly nondeployable research oracle; actual diarizer is called even K=1. The production V1.6 fixed-mode comparison separately substitutes its real full-recording single-speaker bypass on mono cases.

dev_acceptance.raw_wer: Must not regress; frozen verified actual ASR tokens are reassigned to new turns, text/order must remain unchanged. Final integration still requires full inference and Android port validation.

selection_order_among_passing_global_pro: lowest dev native DER at collar 0 ms
simpler policy, baseline weights when tied
if_no_profile_passes: Do not promote Android parameters or replace stable V1.6. Preserve failures, diagnose and continue C research.
validation_before_android: Selected global profile only; original holdout and reserve independently: no raw WER regression and no native DER or exact speaker-count case regression versus their automatic V1.6 baselines. Any failure is kept and blocks promotion.
timing_scope: Host concurrent sweep is quality research. Diarization-stage timings exclude replayed ASR and are not whole-app/phone RTF.
gold_limitations: Speaker identity follows independent actor metadata; interval DER is a constructed utterance-clip proxy, not a natural-dialogue or independent word-alignment acceptance.
